scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.generate:types: OPENAPI_TMP=$(mktemp) && uv run python ../scripts/generate_openapi_doc.py > "$OPENAPI_TMP" && npx openapi-typescript "$OPENAPI_TMP" -o src/generated/dtos.d.ts && rm -f "$OPENAPI_TMP"
scripts.generate:types:check: OPENAPI_TMP=$(mktemp) && DTOS_CHECK=$(mktemp) && uv run python ../scripts/generate_openapi_doc.py > "$OPENAPI_TMP" && npx openapi-typescript "$OPENAPI_TMP" -o "$DTOS_CHECK" && diff -u src/generated/dtos.d.ts "$DTOS_CHECK"; STATUS=$?; rm -f "$OPENAPI_TMP" "$DTOS_CHECK"; exit $STATUS
